fields.description: The name shown on the Employee, the PF Detailed Log and the ECR Upload Statement. To change it later, use Rename (title or ... menu): the employees and logs that use the scheme are updated.
fields.label: Scheme Name

fields.description: How EPS and ER (employer share) are worked out. The Wage Ceiling is the Statutory Wage Ceiling of the Payroll Master Setting of the payroll month.
fields.label: Calculation
fields.options:
EPS 9.49% / ER 2.51% of EPF Wages
EPS 0 / ER 12% of EPF Wages
EPS 8.33% / ER 3.67% on Wages up to the Wage Ceiling
EPS 0 / ER 12% on Wages up to the Wage Ceiling
EPS 8.33% on Wages up to the Wage Ceiling / ER 12% of EPF Wages less EPS
EPS 8.33% (+1.16% above the Wage Ceiling) / ER 12% less EPS
